mods.name: Asset Patches
mods.summary: Fixes the netgun's bullets on every combat map (always on: the game needs it) and puts the community's posters into the arena.
mods.author: marshmallow-mia

mods.name: XMLHTTP Fix
mods.summary: Only for nEVR 4.0.0: gives Echo VR the system's XMLHTTP again, whose stand-in crashes the game in windowed mode. nEVR 4.0.1 does this itself, and its update removes this plugin.
mods.author: marshmallow-mia

mods.name: GPU Rating
mods.summary: Tells the game your GPU's speed where Proton can't, so it starts on the graphics preset Windows would pick instead of Low (always on: it changes nothing where the driver answers itself).
mods.author: marshmallow-mia
